t: Talan Group has acquired Thinkmax | Deals | Oaklins Canada: Mid-market M&A and financial advice globally
s: With expertise in Microsoft Dynamics 365, digital commerce and advanced analytics, Thinkmax enables organizations to streamline operations, enhance customer experience and drive growth. The firm offers end-to-end services, from strategic planning and implementation to ongoing support, helping clients leverage technology to meet evolving market demands. Oaklins’ team in Canada was retained by Talan to help them grow their presence in North America. The team acted as the sole buy-side financial advisor for this transaction.
